description: Live Bitcoin fee rate for a confirmation deadline, read from projected mempool blocks. Uses the marginal inclusion rate of the target block rather than the named fastestFee/halfHourFee buckets, whose block-count semantics are community convention rather than documented. Bitcoin inclusion is fee-rate against ~10-minute blocks, so this is the lever — there is no sub-second race and no VPS advantage. Read-only.

bufferPct.description: Percent above the marginal rate. Default 15.

name: bitcoin_mint_fee_rate
